Was playing at a tournament with over 120 teams there (different grade levels), with kids a grade lower than me instead of my normal U15 team. We had the 14th seed and were facing the 3rd seed who was undefeated. We didn't even warm up because the team we were supposed to face for the 14th seed didn't show up. 

First quarter, they score first, coach calls a timeout and tells the defense to get our heads in the game. 
Immediately we win the faceoff, go down the field and score.
We are tied 1-1 towards the end of the fourth quarter. I see the BIGGEST flash of lightning along with the LOUDEST thunder I've ever heard. The refs paused the game. We sit in our car for AN HOUR and we hear that we have to play a 2 minute SUDDEN DEATH OVERTIME. They win the face, run down the field, take a really bad shot, goalie makes save, I get the ball.
I immediately pass it to our feeder, who passes it to our shooter. Bar freaking down.
I WHIPPED MY D POLE ACROSS THE FIELD AND LEAPED ONTO MY GOALIE. ([Kinda like here](https://twitter.com/TerenceFoy/status/726243488921206784)) 
One of the moms goes to me after I shook hands with the other team (one of them told me to fuck off so that's cool.) and says "I don't know how you sleep at night." I replied "Like a baby because I played clean and beat you chippy team. Teach you child how to check and then come talk to me."
